messages:
ravi: Quick debrief from today's mixed-int4 bring-up experiments on rwdv8. TL;DR: good perf wins but a couple of fidelity hotspots. Full numbers below.

emma: Paste the slice breakdown when you have it. Any surprising memory regressions?

ravi: No OOMs. JVM host pressure same. Raw highlights: throughput ~2.1x on conversational median, overall MRR delta -0.9%, but code-assist slice saw -1.8%. Hallucination rate increased +0.6pp for code-assist, +0.1pp elsewhere. Median latency -25ms, p95 -90ms.

jin: Curious if code-assist regressions are on multi-step edits or long-context completions? Did you compare structured output exact-match?

ravi: It's concentrated on multi-step edit sequences with interleaved user messages. Exact-match on structured outputs dropped from 0.962 -> 0.948 on the dev probe. We ran two fidelity probes: deterministic structured probe and random user-sim probe.

pat: Ok. Proposal: conservative canary with an embedded fidelity probe and duel-shadow baseline. Steps: 3% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%. Soft-hold on any slice if structured exact-match delta < -0.01 OR halluc_delta > 0.0035 for 10m. Auto-fallback to nf4-stable on sustained violation for 20m. Also keep a 15% shadow to nf4 for comparison.

emma: For consumer-facing search product, tighten the halluc_threshold to 0.002 and require 5m sustained before hold. For enterprise LLM features, 0.004 is fine. We'll need an ops-runbook update.

jin: Add a rolling smoke eval that runs the structured probe every 2 minutes and tags any mismatch with session id + payload. Also surface the top-10 failure prompts to the convo-lab channel.

ravi: Draft rollout config below. Will wire into Console and create rollout job.

```json
{
  "variant": "mixed-int4",
  "canary_steps": [3, 10, 40, 100],
  "shadow_compare": {"pct": 15, "baseline": "nf4-stable"},
  "fidelity_probes": [
    {"name": "structured_exact","promptset": "rwd_fidelity_v3","interval_secs": 120,"exact_match_threshold": 0.985},
    {"name": "random_user_sim","promptset": "rwd_user_sim_v1","interval_secs": 300}
  ],
  "signals": [
    {"slice": "code-assist","metric": "mrr","delta_threshold": -0.01,"window_mins": 10,"action": "hold"},
    {"slice": "code-assist","metric": "halluc_rate","delta_threshold": 0.0035,"window_mins": 10,"action": "hold"},
    {"metric": "p95_latency","delta_threshold": 0.0,"window_mins": 30,"action": "throttle_if_increase"}
  ],
  "auto_fallback": {"on_sustained_violation_mins": 20, "route_to": "nf4-stable"},
  "routing_overrides": [
    {"condition": "session_length_tokens > 4096","route_to": "nf4-stable"},
    {"condition": "feature_flag.user_tier == \"enterprise\"","halluc_threshold": 0.004}
  ],
  "alerts": {"paging": {"halluc_delta_pp": 0.02, "window_mins": 5}, "non_paging": {"halluc_delta_pp": 0.01, "window_mins": 10}}
}
```

ops-bot: Rollout config accepted. Scheduled canary job pending manual approval from @eng-ml leads. :gear:

jin: Please include an automatic snapshot exporter for any fidelity probe failures (upload to s3 path: s3://rw-inference/canary-failures/mixed-int4/YYYYMMDD/).avi: Will add the snapshot exporter and an abbreviated 'why-failed' JSON for triage. I'll also include the session-level shadow logs for the 15% shadow traffic.

emma: Thanks. Once the rollout job is approved, we'll kick the canary and monitor the smoke evals. Keep the runbook handy and tag eng-sre if the paging alert trips. :+1:
